title: Contextual Replay Bench and Drift Watcher for Reranker Embeddings
creator: Aisha Rao
description: Build a reproducible evaluation harness that replays sampled production context windows into the embedding + reranker pipeline to measure accuracy, latency tails, and scale behavior. The system will map replayed queries to a configurable golden answer set and compute offline metrics (MAP, MRR, nDCG), latency percentiles, and resource profiles. It must also include a continuous drift watcher that compares recent production embedding distributions against gold anchors and triggers alerts when similarity/quality degrades beyond thresholds.
background_and_motivation: Current embedding quality signals are fragmented: we have nightly goldset runs but they lack realistic context (multi-turn, user metadata) and they do not exercise the reranker end-to-end. Product engineering has observed intermittent regressions after model swaps and quantization changes where offline metrics passed but production relevance fell. We need a middle-ground harness that replays realistic contexts, captures reranker ranking delta, and surfaces covariate drift in embeddings so rollouts can be gated by meaningful signals.
approach_overview: 1) Ingest anonymized, sampled request traces (context windows + labels where available) into a replay micro-batch runner. 2) For each replay, compute embeddings for top candidate set, run reranker, and compare to golden ranking via multiple metrics. 3) Produce both per-request deltas and aggregated telemetry: MAP@K, MRR, nDCG@10, embedding cosine drift, histogram of L2 differences, and latency p50/p95/p99 for embed+rerank steps. 4) Run targeted scale experiments by sweeping batch sizes and concurrent runners to map latency vs throughput tradeoffs. 5) Ship continuous drift watcher with weekly anchors and alerting rules integrated into Redwood Console.
implementation_notes: - Use existing trace export pipeline (privacy-preserving sampling) as the source. - Build the replay runner as a k8s job and a lightweight local dev mode. - Store golden mappings in an immutable S3 prefix with versioned manifests. - Re-use runtime inference clients to ensure fidelity with production (same batching and kernel paths). - Telemetry will publish to the new eval-metrics topic and a Grafana dashboard is pre-provisioned.
acceptance_criteria: Replay runner can execute 10k sampled contexts in a single run and produce per-request ranking outputs
Computed offline metrics (MAP, MRR, nDCG) match reference harness within 2% on baseline models
Latency profile reports p50/p95/p99 for embed and rerank stages and artifacts stored for historical comparison
Drift watcher computes weekly embedding distribution distance and raises alerts when similarity to anchor falls below threshold
A console dashboard displays trend lines and a drill-down for failing contexts with links to trace IDs
tasks: T1: Define sampling policy and privacy filters for trace export
T2: Design golden mapping format and storage layout (manifest + lineage metadata)
T3: Implement replay runner CLI + k8s job spec
T4: Wire runtime client into harness to ensure same kernels and batching behavior
T5: Implement metric calculators (MAP, MRR, nDCG) and embedding drift measures
T6: Build scale test harness to sweep concurrency and batch sizes
T7: Integrate outputs into eval-metrics topic and Grafana dashboard
T8: Create alerting rules and runbook for drift incidents
T9: Run cross-team validation with Product and Research and collect sign-off
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Replay traces may contain PII. Mitigation: apply anonymization filters and require privacy review before enabling full sampling.
Risk: Differences between harness and production runtime (batches/kernel paths) could mask regressions. Mitigation: reuse production runtime client and run a canary on Dedicated capacity.
Risk: Golden set drift causing false positives. Mitigation: use rolling anchors and allow manual annotation to refresh gold mappings.
